Freshers, listen up 👇

Last week (Aug 31 – Sep 6), we posted 𝟯𝟭𝟭 𝘃𝗲𝗿𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗷𝗼𝗯𝘀 — through one of the slowest markets in years.

Now the game is changing 🔄

📅 Campus & off-campus placement season kicks off this month. Companies that were holding openings for months will start releasing them.

𝗧𝗵𝗲 𝗾𝘂𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝗶𝘀 — 𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗬𝗢𝗨 𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆? 🤔

Ask yourself:
✔️ Is my resume updated?
✔️ Do I have 1-2 projects to show?
✔️ Is my GitHub/portfolio active?
✔️ Am I applying within 24 hours of every opening?

If any answer is NO — fix it THIS week. When the wave comes, prepared freshers get the offers. 🌊

We'll be posting every genuine opening the moment it drops. Don't miss a single one 👇
